doc.mfu_pct: achieved_TFLOPS / 989e12 × 100  (H100 FP16 dense sparse spec). Industry-comparable.
doc.hfu_pct: achieved_TFLOPS / 660e12 × 100  (H100 FP16 measured at this pod's 700W cap). Internal diagnosis.
doc.dollar_per_M_tok_power_only: POWER COST ONLY at $0.10/kWh. Excludes capital amortization, DC overhead (cooling/networking), ops costs, and margin. Full neocloud $/M tok is typically 50-100x this. CIPHER affects only the power-cost portion.
doc.fairness_ratio: max(per_tenant_tps) / max(min(per_tenant_tps), 1e-9). Stop threshold = 1.10 in this sweep.
doc.flops_per_token: Per-token forward FLOPS for Mistral-7B at the configured mean_seq_len (prefill_len + max_decode/2).
